Name: Cow Chop Mod
Author: sierragh
Description:
Replaces Sebastian with James and Sam with (blonde™) Aleks. All of the name mentions are replaced. Some of the dialogue is replaced. A certain couch is replaced. It's a good time. 
Contains cursing.
Files are placed within analogous folders in the download. You can't copy the whole content folder into your original content folder. Copy the files out of each folder and put them in the folder of the same name in your game content. Y'all probably already know that.
Also this is the first mod I've made and I did it during finals week, so don't judge.

Mod by Sierra Hughes
Dialogue by Sierra Hughes and Tena Smith
